lake-gairdner.name: Lake Gairdner National Park
lake-gairdner.bio: Salt lake with over 200 islands north of the Gawler Ranges, reached by a 34 km station track from Mount Ive.

notes.pin: Wikipedia park point is provisional (lake centroid). Park page: main route via Mount Ive station, 34 km track; Waltumba Tank campground on the western side (Stringer Hwy towards Glendambo). Use a visitor point, not the centroid.
notes.cost: Park page: Free entry, open daily. Mount Ive station charges a fee for the gate key (private, not a park fee); mention not in bio. Not a Desert Parks Pass park per page.
notes.other: Wiki title Lake Gairdner National Park equals name, so wiki omitted.

unverified: Mount Ive gate-key fee amount not stated on park page
notes: Cowell, Tumby Bay, Cleve, Elliston are destinations themselves (no spot entries; note says so), so nothing written for them in this shard.
